body.message:
Hello,
Thank you for your message. However, it seems we are coming back to the same starting point. As I previously shared with you (including a screenshot), I have already had a negative experience in a similar situation, and I cannot commit to this type of arrangement again.
I am specifically looking for a long-term rental where I won’t have to move out after a few months due to reasons such as the owner deciding to sell or changes in market prices. Stability is very important for me.
I can provide cheques as a guarantee, but I am only able to proceed with monthly payments.
Thank you for your understanding.
